#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b) {
        int t = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = t;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    int x, y, limit;
    cin >> x >> y >> limit;
    double bestDist = 1e9;
    double target = (double)x / y;
    int bestNum = 0, bestDen = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= limit; ++i) {
        long long b = (1LL * x * i) / y;
        int nums[3] = { (int)b, abs((int)b - 1), (int)b + 1 };
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            double approx = (double)nums[j] / i;
            double dist = fabs(target - approx);
            if (dist < bestDist) {
                bestDist = dist;
                bestNum = nums[j];
                bestDen = i;
            }
        }
    }
    double distOne = fabs(1.0 - target);
    double distBest = fabs((double)bestNum / bestDen - target);
    if (distOne <= distBest + 1e-9) {
        bestNum = 1;
        bestDen = 1;
    }
    int g = gcd(bestNum, bestDen);
    cout << bestNum / g << "/" << bestDen / g << endl;
    return 0;
}
